records.name: Generate binary
records.purpose: The `ultimate-ai-generate` executable that rewrites Skill files and LLM-context files.
records.surface: See [authored signatures and interpretation](README.md). Arguments skillsDir and contextDir default to cwd/skills and cwd/dist/context. It regenerates existing Skill files in place or creates missing ones for every ALL_COMPONENTS record, writes the five context files, logs to stderr and exits 1 on Skill regeneration errors. `generateAllSkillFiles(skillsDir)` is exported from the module but not the root. The package build script runs it against ../../skills and context, so a build rewrites repository files.
